title: M4C / Legacy System Reference
summary: Withdrawn reference to M4C. The surviving material suggests a legacy system, designation or programme rather than a conventional individual. Context remains insufficient.
body:
SUBJECT

M4C

M4C appears in legacy documentation without a consistent description. Surviving references alternate between what appears to be a system designation and a programme identifier.

No reliable person, corporation or military unit has been matched to the term.

This record is retained primarily because the designation recurs in otherwise unrelated material.

ARCHIVE NOTE

Do not merge with similarly formatted machine or programme identifiers without independent corroboration.
